cases.false_positive_boundary: UnreachableJwtNone.kt keeps alg=none acceptance retired and exports verifier-backed token handling.

expected_tests: setup hook performs no network I/O
retired callback is not invoked by install path

cases.data_flow: gem post_install hook -> ENV user -> Net::HTTP callback to undeclared host
cases.expected_remediation: Remove gem install-time network callbacks and keep package lifecycle behavior local and deterministic.
expected_tests: retired callback helper is not invoked

cases.data_flow: dashboard startup -> WebSocket open handler -> user identifiers to undeclared beacon host

expected_tests: dashboard startup does not instantiate WebSocket

cases.data_flow: invoice id + environment user -> direct smtplib.SMTP callback to undeclared host
cases.expected_remediation: Remove direct SMTP callbacks from invoice processing and use only documented mail subsystems with approval.

cases.data_flow: update check -> http.Client with Transport Proxy nil -> direct outbound request bypassing configured proxy controls
cases.expected_remediation: Remove proxy-bypassing transports and require injected clients that inherit approved egress policy.

cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_proxy_bypass.go keeps a retired direct client helper, but exported update fetch uses the caller-provided client.

cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_metadata_alias.js keeps a retired metadata debug helper, but the exported route blocks known metadata aliases.

cases.data_flow: dependency update hook -> lockfile packages + environment user -> https.request to undeclared host
cases.expected_remediation: Remove dependency-update callbacks that exfiltrate lockfile or environment data to undeclared hosts.

cases.data_flow: GET /orders/:orderId -> orders.findById(orderId) -> JSON response without account ownership check
cases.expected_remediation: Check loaded order ownership against req.user.accountId before returning the order, preserving session middleware behavior.
expected_tests: unauthenticated order read still requires login
cases.false_positive_boundary: unreachable_orders.js keeps a retired admin lookup helper, but the exported route checks order.accountId against req.user.accountId before responding.

exploit_preconditions: attacker knows or guesses another account's order id
quality_metadata.trust_boundary: HTTP route boundary between authenticated caller and account-scoped order data
quality_metadata.data_sensitivity: customer order totals and account identifiers
quality_metadata.production_likelihood: high for multi-tenant order APIs that use shared numeric or guessable IDs
quality_metadata.approval_gate: service owner approval for authorization model and route test coverage
quality_metadata.blast_radius: cross-account order disclosure for any guessed order id
false_positive_traps: retiredAdminOrderLookup is present but not exported as the active route
session middleware exists but authenticates only; it does not authorize ownership
